scope: Text effects mode; Animated Headline shapes and rotation variants are separate.
selectionGuidance: Match the visual reference and use case, then check playback and layout constraints. These are design suggestions, not guarantees of engagement. Preserve legibility, respect reduced motion, and keep essential information available without animation.

playbackDefinitions.entrance: Plays once and settles; replay can trigger it again.
playbackDefinitions.finite-sequence: Several phases play once and then settle.
playbackDefinitions.pointer: Includes a pointer-driven response after its entrance.
playbackDefinitions.loop-scroll: Continuous movement that also responds to scrolling.
playbackDefinitions.configurable-loop: Repeats by default; a module option can disable repetition.

effects.name: Appear text
effects.description: Rows of repeated words drift, zoom and wipe around a central word.
effects.resembles: A kinetic typography poster or moving word wall.
effects.useWhen: Short brand names and expressive campaign hero sections.
effects.avoidWhen: Paragraphs and compact layouts: it creates a large repeated grid.

effects.name: Blur reveal
effects.description: Text fades from a soft blur into sharp, readable letters.
effects.resembles: A camera finding focus.
effects.useWhen: Quiet hero introductions, editorial titles and premium product headings.
effects.avoidWhen: Tiny text or dense copy, where temporary blur delays reading.

effects.name: Cinema title
effects.description: Very wide letter spacing contracts while the entire title fades in.
effects.resembles: Opening credits and cinematic title cards.
effects.useWhen: Short film titles, launches and dramatic chapter openings.
effects.avoidWhen: Long sentences or narrow containers: the initial tracking needs space.

effects.name: Clip wrap
effects.description: Characters slide out from clipped wrappers in the chosen direction.
effects.resembles: Type emerging from behind a mask.
effects.useWhen: Clean section headings, portfolio titles and restrained reveals.
effects.avoidWhen: Tall accents or tight line heights that may be clipped; preview your font.

effects.name: Continuous wave
effects.description: Text units keep bobbing vertically with an offset between neighbors.
effects.resembles: A traveling ripple or floating ribbon.
effects.useWhen: Playful slogans, music projects and small decorative labels.
effects.avoidWhen: Body copy and multiple competing headlines: the motion never settles.

effects.name: Crt boot
effects.description: Text expands from a thin horizontal line, then clears its blur.
effects.resembles: An old CRT monitor switching on.
effects.useWhen: Retro computing, arcade themes and nostalgic introductions.
effects.avoidWhen: Calm editorial content or places where a sudden screen-like flash feels out of place.

effects.name: Dia text reveal
effects.description: A diagonal clipping mask uncovers the phrase.
effects.resembles: An angled wipe across a title.
effects.useWhen: Fashion, architecture and editorial section transitions.
effects.avoidWhen: Small text and crowded compositions where the diagonal reveal adds little.

effects.name: Echo clone
effects.description: Cloned characters slide vertically inside clipped wrappers.
effects.resembles: A typographic echo or stacked print impression.
effects.useWhen: Bold short headings, creative studios and rhythmic titles.
effects.avoidWhen: Dense paragraphs; the cloned-letter treatment needs room and readable type.

effects.name: Elastic text
effects.description: The phrase follows the nearby pointer with a spring response and colored trails.
effects.resembles: Elastic material pulled by a cursor.
effects.useWhen: Desktop portfolio heroes and experimental brand signatures.
effects.avoidWhen: Touch-first essential interactions: the signature response depends on a pointer.

effects.name: Explosion
effects.description: Oversized text units shrink rapidly into their final positions.
effects.resembles: An explosive zoom resolving into a word.
effects.useWhen: Announcements, game titles and brief high-impact statements.
effects.avoidWhen: Long headings or subtle interfaces; the initial scale needs generous space.

effects.name: Flip board
effects.description: Units hinge downward from their top edge in a tight stagger.
effects.resembles: An airport departure board or mechanical split-flap sign.
effects.useWhen: Travel titles, event names and short information labels.
effects.avoidWhen: Continuous live data or long copy; this is an entrance, not a data-update system.

effects.name: Flip in
effects.description: Text units rotate into view around a directional 3D hinge.
effects.resembles: A hinged card turning toward the reader.
effects.useWhen: Feature headings and structured card entrances.
effects.avoidWhen: Several adjacent 3D effects or lengthy sentences that become slow to reveal.

effects.name: Glitch
effects.description: Quick horizontal jolts decrease until the text settles.
effects.resembles: A briefly corrupted digital signal.
effects.useWhen: Cyberpunk titles, games and technology campaign accents.
effects.avoidWhen: Error messages or critical instructions, where simulated corruption confuses meaning.

effects.name: Gradient flow text
effects.description: A colored gradient travels continuously through the letter shapes.
effects.resembles: Flowing light or an aurora inside the text.
effects.useWhen: Brand words and product hero accents with large type.
effects.avoidWhen: Low-contrast palettes and small text; every gradient phase must stay legible.

effects.name: Heartbeat
effects.description: Text fades in, pulses twice in scale and settles.
effects.resembles: A short double heartbeat.
effects.useWhen: Emotional campaign words, celebration and a single emphasis beat.
effects.avoidWhen: Persistent status indicators: it is a finite pulse, not a monitoring signal.

effects.name: Letter roll
effects.description: Characters rise and rotate into place; optional hover replay rolls them again.
effects.resembles: Rolling letter tiles.
effects.useWhen: Short navigation-like labels, portfolio headings and playful titles.
effects.avoidWhen: Long copy; do not require hover for the message to be understood.

effects.name: Letter swap
effects.description: Letter slots reveal, then slide duplicate letters up and back in an automatic cycle.
effects.resembles: A mechanical letter swap or rolling label.
effects.useWhen: Short expressive headings and text with a tactile character.
effects.avoidWhen: Actual word replacement: the duplicate letters contain the same text.

effects.name: Line shadow text
effects.description: An outlined duplicate drifts diagonally behind the solid phrase.
effects.resembles: Offset print, hatching and layered type.
effects.useWhen: Display headings, posters and creative identity work.
effects.avoidWhen: Small fonts or busy backgrounds that merge the shadow with the main text.

effects.name: Liquid fill
effects.description: A clipped text layer fills upward within an outlined phrase.
effects.resembles: Liquid rising inside hollow lettering.
effects.useWhen: Beverage, water and playful product campaign headings.
effects.avoidWhen: Thin or small type; the fill is most readable inside broad letterforms.

effects.name: Matrix rain
effects.description: Units fall into position in randomized order.
effects.resembles: Digital rain resolving into a message.
effects.useWhen: Developer events, code-themed launches and futuristic titles.
effects.avoidWhen: A continuous rain background: this effect lands and settles once.

effects.name: Mesh text
effects.description: A WebGL text surface distorts locally with pointer movement.
effects.resembles: A flexible mesh or liquid digital fabric.
effects.useWhen: Large experimental desktop headings and interactive art direction.
effects.avoidWhen: Body text, selectable copy or essential mobile interactions; it uses a canvas and pointer.

effects.name: Neon flicker
effects.description: Text flashes through brief opacity changes before staying visible.
effects.resembles: A neon sign struggling to switch on.
effects.useWhen: Nightlife, retro signage and short atmospheric titles.
effects.avoidWhen: Reading-heavy pages or interfaces where flicker would distract from a task.

effects.name: Pendulum swing
effects.description: Units swing down from a rotated position and settle elastically.
effects.resembles: Hanging signs or pendulums.
effects.useWhen: Playful labels, educational displays and cheerful introductions.
effects.avoidWhen: Rigid, understated layouts or long phrases with many swinging units.

effects.name: Perspective fly
effects.description: Characters travel forward from deep 3D space.
effects.resembles: A title flying toward the camera.
effects.useWhen: Game, film and technology hero headings.
effects.avoidWhen: Compact cards and subtle copy; depth motion should be used sparingly.

effects.name: Rgb split
effects.description: Separated red and cyan shadows converge into a tight colored glow.
effects.resembles: Chromatic aberration or an anaglyph print.
effects.useWhen: Retro-futuristic titles and short digital-brand accents.
effects.avoidWhen: Small type or backgrounds that compete with the colored outlines.

effects.name: Rotate in
effects.description: Units turn into place around a corner pivot in the chosen direction.
effects.resembles: Loose paper letters being rotated into alignment.
effects.useWhen: Casual headings, creative section titles and light editorial motion.
effects.avoidWhen: Formal body copy and layouts that cannot allow space around rotating letters.

effects.name: Rotating dial
effects.description: Characters are positioned around a circle and the dial spins continuously.
effects.resembles: A rotating seal or instrument dial.
effects.useWhen: Short decorative badges and compact circular brand marks.
effects.avoidWhen: A primary readable sentence; the circular layout changes normal reading order.

effects.name: Rubber stamp
effects.description: Large, tilted units slam into place and rebound.
effects.resembles: An ink stamp hitting paper.
effects.useWhen: Short announcements, approved-style labels and punchy campaign words.
effects.avoidWhen: Neutral system statuses where the theatrical impact could imply an unintended meaning.

effects.name: Scale in
effects.description: Small text units grow into place with a slight overshoot.
effects.resembles: A soft pop or expanding label.
effects.useWhen: Friendly feature titles, onboarding headings and lightweight emphasis.
effects.avoidWhen: Many simultaneous labels; repeated popping can overwhelm a dense interface.

effects.name: Scatter converge
effects.description: Letters move from random offsets and angles into their final alignment.
effects.resembles: Scattered pieces assembling into a word.
effects.useWhen: Creative problem-solving stories, brand reveals and short hero messages.
effects.avoidWhen: Essential copy that must be readable immediately; the starting positions are dispersed.

effects.name: Scramble
effects.description: Temporary characters resolve into the intended text.
effects.resembles: Decoding, a terminal or a cipher revealing a message.
effects.useWhen: Developer tools, cyber themes and brief discovery moments.
effects.avoidWhen: Passwords, codes or important numbers that could be mistaken for the temporary characters.

effects.name: Scroll highlight
effects.description: Text units change from a dim color toward the original color as the page scrolls.
effects.resembles: A reading spotlight moving across a statement.
effects.useWhen: Editorial manifestos and short scroll-driven narratives.
effects.avoidWhen: A static viewport with no scroll range; the effect needs page movement to progress.

effects.name: Scroll velocity marquee
effects.description: Repeated text moves horizontally and responds to scrolling speed.
effects.resembles: An animated ticker or kinetic editorial ribbon.
effects.useWhen: Decorative brand phrases and full-width campaign bands.
effects.avoidWhen: Essential one-time information; repetition and motion make normal reading harder.

effects.name: Shiny sweep text
effects.description: A luminous band repeatedly sweeps across the text.
effects.resembles: A metallic reflection or a polished surface catching light.
effects.useWhen: Premium product names, short badges and display words.
effects.avoidWhen: Long text or low-contrast palettes where the moving shine hides letterforms.

effects.name: Skew in
effects.description: Text units enter with a slanted distortion and straighten.
effects.resembles: Fast-moving type braking into alignment.
effects.useWhen: Sports headings, energetic product launches and short action statements.
effects.avoidWhen: Quiet reading experiences or narrow letterforms that become difficult to recognize.

effects.name: Slide in
effects.description: Units slide into place from the chosen direction with configurable easing.
effects.resembles: A clean interface transition or a title entering a stage.
effects.useWhen: General-purpose headings and restrained section introductions; use smooth easing for subtle motion.
effects.avoidWhen: Long staggered paragraphs; prefer words or lines when character-by-character motion is too slow.

effects.name: Slot machine
effects.description: Units travel downward from far above and slow into alignment.
effects.resembles: Slot reels or rolling counters coming to rest.
effects.useWhen: Game-inspired headlines, playful numbers and promotional labels.
effects.avoidWhen: Real counters or random outcomes: it animates fixed content, not changing values.

effects.name: Sparkles text
effects.description: The phrase fades in while small stars twinkle repeatedly around it.
effects.resembles: Glitter, magic dust or a celebratory sparkle.
effects.useWhen: Short celebratory words, creative tools and playful brand highlights.
effects.avoidWhen: Serious instructions or crowded layouts; the surrounding decoration keeps moving.

effects.name: Spin in
effects.description: Text units spin through two turns while growing into place.
effects.resembles: Spinning tokens or a playful whirlwind.
effects.useWhen: Very short game titles, festive words and informal display text.
effects.avoidWhen: Professional body copy or large groups of units; the rotation is intentionally strong.

effects.name: Spinning circular text
effects.description: The phrase is repeated around a ring that rotates slowly.
effects.resembles: An orbiting text seal or circular editorial badge.
effects.useWhen: Decorative callouts, portfolio emblems and short repeating brand phrases.
effects.avoidWhen: A normal heading or long statement; the ring is ornamental and repeats content.

effects.name: Spiral in
effects.description: Units converge from circular offsets while rotating and scaling up.
effects.resembles: Letters gathering from a spiral.
effects.useWhen: Imaginative brand reveals, art projects and playful campaign headings.
effects.avoidWhen: Tight spaces or text that must be recognized at first glance.

effects.name: Split chars
effects.description: Characters rise into view with a sequential stagger.
effects.resembles: A classic staggered typographic reveal.
effects.useWhen: Clean hero headings, portfolios and measured editorial introductions.
effects.avoidWhen: Long paragraphs where individual character delays create unnecessary waiting.

effects.name: Stagger flip 3d
effects.description: Letter faces roll through a staggered 3D cube-like flip and settle.
effects.resembles: Rotating letter blocks or mechanical display tiles.
effects.useWhen: Bold short headings and tactile digital identities.
effects.avoidWhen: Thin fonts, dense text and layouts where the depth treatment becomes hard to read.

effects.name: Stretch warp
effects.description: Wide, flattened units spring back to their natural proportions.
effects.resembles: Rubber lettering snapping into shape.
effects.useWhen: Playful product campaigns and expressive display typography.
effects.avoidWhen: Logos with strict proportions or copy that needs immediate recognition.

effects.name: Text emerge
effects.description: Letters expand from a blurred state outward from the middle of the phrase.
effects.resembles: A word blooming from its center.
effects.useWhen: Short focal statements, reveal moments and balanced centered compositions.
effects.avoidWhen: Long uneven lines, where the center-out sequence can be difficult to follow.

effects.name: Text highlighter
effects.description: A translucent marker stroke sweeps behind a stationary phrase.
effects.resembles: A hand-drawn highlighter on paper.
effects.useWhen: Emphasizing a key promise, quoted phrase or editorial takeaway.
effects.avoidWhen: Low contrast or several highlighted sentences competing for attention; keep the emphasis selective.

effects.name: Text reveal wall
effects.description: Rows of changing characters reveal words, settle, then reverse when looping is enabled.
effects.resembles: A decoding terminal wall or typographic data display.
effects.useWhen: Large experimental hero panels and short technology-themed messages.
effects.avoidWhen: Inline text and compact headings: the multi-row composition needs a dedicated area.

effects.name: Typewriter
effects.description: Units become visible one after another with a typing-like delay.
effects.resembles: A terminal or a typewriter composing a sentence.
effects.useWhen: Short introductions, dialogue and code-related messages.
effects.avoidWhen: Long instructions or copy readers need immediately; the reveal takes time.

effects.name: Typewriter delete
effects.description: The phrase types in, pauses, deletes, and types in again once.
effects.resembles: Someone editing a line at a terminal.
effects.useWhen: Short taglines and a deliberate rewrite or reconsideration moment.
effects.avoidWhen: Rotating several phrases: this effect repeats the same text and is not an infinite rotator.

effects.name: Unfold 3d
effects.description: Units rotate on two axes and grow into their final positions.
effects.resembles: Folded cards or paper unfolding in space.
effects.useWhen: Creative product reveals and short dimensional headings.
effects.avoidWhen: Dense layouts and long copy where many simultaneous folds compete.

effects.name: Vertical blinds
effects.description: Text units widen from thin vertical slivers into full glyphs.
effects.resembles: Vertical blinds opening.
effects.useWhen: Architectural, geometric and clean editorial titles.
effects.avoidWhen: Very thin type or small text, where the compressed opening is hard to distinguish.

effects.name: Vhs tracking
effects.description: Short horizontal shifts, skew and opacity disruptions settle into readable text.
effects.resembles: A VHS tape stabilizing its tracking.
effects.useWhen: Analog nostalgia, music releases and retro video titles.
effects.avoidWhen: Critical information and minimal interfaces, where simulated playback errors are distracting.

effects.name: Wave
effects.description: Units start at different vertical offsets and settle in a ripple.
effects.resembles: A gentle wave flattening into a line.
effects.useWhen: Friendly section titles and a brief organic entrance.
effects.avoidWhen: Continuous ambient motion: choose Continuous Wave if the movement should keep repeating.
